turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
Then answer me, Hale. Who decided?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
Late homework from September, used to keep me out of the principal's office. You can explain that threat to the principal yourself, this afternoon.
No, Hale, yours. What do you actually have on that essay?
